owner_directive: Build the complete repository-executed FRANK simulation Harness to release quality before LoRA-1. First finish the normal Reference Harness, then rebuild the same frozen architecture in ClayCode. Every Harness must have its own ClayGraph. Digital Retina is mandatory in H1/H2/H3 so the target FRANK is multimodal.
coordination_rule: Every harness worker joins this workspace, reads all current branch inputs, Project-Frankenstein archaeology, Drive Digital Retina lineage, current per-Harness ClayGraphs and live claims, claims a non-overlapping highest-value package, executes code/tests, cross-reads siblings and writes completion plus affected-branch feedback receipts.
hard_invariants: no Harness without its own ClayGraph
static Harness ClayGraph must validate against executed architecture
Golden Traces must emit dynamic Run ClayGraph or deterministic graph deltas
Clay Harness must implement the same frozen architecture as Reference Harness
Clay Harness PASS requires state and ClayGraph differential equivalence against Reference Harness
Digital Retina visual perception is mandatory in Reference Harness, Clay Harness and One-Module/Binary FRANK
Digital Retina semantic output into FRANK must be provenance-bound Clay-native VisualPercept state; raw pixels/tensors/embeddings are physical backing only
visual perception must be traceable through gating/selection, GWT broadcast, causal use, memory/action and re-entry with stale/shuffled/lesion controls
historical Project-Frankenstein mechanisms/failures and Drive Digital Retina mechanisms/failures must be catalogued and checked before relevant module release

H-WP-00-ARCHAEOLOGY-INGEST.goal: Continuously ingest Project-Frankenstein architecture archaeology, Drive Digital Retina lineage, successes, failures, equations, papers and emergent-coupling lineage into Harness decisions.

H-WP-01-FREEZE-COMPILER.goal: Compile exact current compatible FRANK+overlay architecture freeze with hashes and module/state/transition/coupling graph, including mandatory Digital Retina visual perception.

H-WP-02-STATE-LEDGER.goal: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots and deterministic hashing.

H-WP-03-CLAYCODE-ADAPTER.goal: Integrate frozen ClayCode parser/canonicalizer/validator/evaluator and ClayReaderFrame projection.

H-WP-04-NEEDLE-BOUNDARY.goal: Model unchanged translator->Needle->Clay boundary and exact Needle receipts without merging Needle into model.

H-WP-05-UNIFIEDDB.goal: Typed logical query/result/selection/transaction/replay simulation with physical-placement separation, including VisualPercept identity/provenance persistence.

H-WP-06-CLAYGRAPH.goal: Memory-use admissibility, routing, activation, Assembly, exact bypass, quarantine/escalation and scoped credit, including visual-perception causal edges.

H-WP-06B-REFERENCE-HARNESS-GRAPH.goal: Generate and validate REFERENCE_HARNESS_ARCHITECTURE.claygraph.json plus dynamic run graph deltas from the executed Reference Harness.

H-WP-07-GWT.goal: Competition, WorkspaceEpisode, broadcast envelope and per-receiver delivery/reconstruction/uptake/causal-use/outcome/reentry chain.

H-WP-07-VISION-DIGITAL-RETINA.goal: Ingest historical Drive Digital Retina; implement deterministic visual fixtures and typed VisualPercept pipeline; integrate thalamic/attention gating, GWT, memory/world/self/action; add stale/replay/shuffle/lesion/rescue tests; preserve identical semantics through H1/H2/H3.

H-WP-08-SELF-BODY-GOALS.goal: Persistent personality/E-PQ, world/self model, DigitalBodyState, goals/commitments/reflection/drift state, including multimodal visual world-state updates.

H-WP-09-MODEL-ADAPTER.goal: Narrow model interface with deterministic fixtures now and Together/Qwen adapter only after authorization; include typed visual-context fixtures without granting visual model output authority.

H-WP-10-EFFECT-AUTHORITY.goal: Frozen proposal/intent/resource/authority/reservation/commit/outcome/reentry semantics; no model-text or visual-model output authority.

H-WP-11-TRACE-REPLAY.goal: Complete per-turn trace bundles, full/checkpoint/module/counterfactual replay, dynamic Run ClayGraphs and golden traces, including visual evidence identity/provenance.

H-WP-12-ABLATION.goal: Module and graph-edge lesions, policy swaps, state perturbations and matched counterfactual runner, including Digital Retina and visual-to-GWT lesions.

H-WP-13-RECOVERY.goal: Crash/restart, idempotency, stale epochs, partial-effect boundaries, rebuild and rollback tests.

H-WP-14-FUZZ-ADVERSARIAL.goal: Property/fuzz/mutation/adversarial/race/concurrency tests across architecture and graph boundaries, including malformed/stale/adversarial visual percepts.

H-WP-15-PERFORMANCE.goal: Latency/cost/token/RAM/state-and-graph-amplification instrumentation without semantic shortcuts, including visual pipeline cost.

H-WP-16-E2E.goal: Long-horizon multi-turn Test-1 simulations with deterministic model and visual fixtures and later Clay-native 4B.

H-WP-17-REFERENCE-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Reference Harness architecture coverage, Digital Retina multimodal coverage, ClayGraph validation, state schemas, golden traces, replay validation, ablation matrix, tests and PASS decision.

H-WP-18-CLAY-HARNESS.goal: Rebuild the identical frozen Reference Harness architecture in ClayCode, including Digital Retina VisualPercept semantics.

H-WP-19-CLAY-HARNESS-GRAPH.goal: Generate/validate CLAY_HARNESS_ARCHITECTURE.claygraph.json and dynamic run graphs from Clay Harness execution.

H-WP-20-DIFFERENTIAL.goal: Compare Reference vs Clay Harness state transitions, receipts, topology, visual semantics, dynamic causal-use graphs and intervention outcomes.

H-WP-21-CLAY-RELEASE-AUDIT.goal: Clay Harness PASS decision; reopen ClayCode if equivalent FRANK or Digital Retina semantics cannot be expressed.

live_claims.scope: Canonical event/state ledger, epochs, provenance, snapshots, deterministic hashing and replay foundation
